name: Sapphire Battlegrounds 3
description: A tournament played only on Sapphire: a Swiss phase, then a knockout of 16 players with best-of-3 matches.
additional_rules: By explicit agreement of both players the timer and the length of simultaneous turns can be adjusted

settings.additional_rules: Early encounter: if the players meet on turn 117 or earlier, either of them may have the map generated again. After such a restart, a meeting on turn 116 or earlier counts as an early encounter
